question: The Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) scheme targets children aged 0–6 years and pregnant/lactating women. Which of the following is NOT one of the six services provided under ICDS?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Supplementary nutrition (take-home rations/hot cooked meals) is one of the six core ICDS services delivered through Anganwadi Centres.
Immunisation (coordinated with the health department through the Anganwadi Centre) is one of the six ICDS services.

Correct. ICDS does not provide secondary hospital care. Severely Acutely Malnourished (SAM) children requiring inpatient care are managed through Nutrition Rehabilitation Centres (NRCs), which are a separate health system component. ICDS focuses on preventive and promotive nutrition at the community level.
Nutrition and health education (counselling mothers, community awareness) is one of the six core ICDS services.

overallFeedback.feedback: The six ICDS services are: supplementary nutrition, immunisation, health check-up, referral services, pre-school education, and nutrition/health education. Secondary hospital care is not part of ICDS.

Correct! The six ICDS services are: supplementary nutrition, immunisation, health check-up, referral services, pre-school non-formal education, and nutrition/health education. Hospital care is NOT included.
